packageRules.description: Docker digest-only refreshes (same tag, new sha) have no release timestamp on lscr.io/ghcr, so the renovate/stability-days check pends FOREVER and automerge can never fire — those PRs sat open indefinitely. Same-tag rebuilds skip the age gate; the 14-day supply-chain quarantine stays intact for real version bumps. Scoped to the Docker managers on purpose: github-actions digest updates (tag re-pointing) keep the full gate, which works there because GitHub provides timestamps. ignoreTests is required on top of the null age gate: dropping stability-days left digest PRs with ZERO status checks, and in a repo with no CI Renovate won't automerge a check-less PR without it (internalChecksAsSuccess has no internal checks to count here).

Automerge GitHub Actions bumps too (they were excluded from the docker-compose automerge rule and sat open forever). Version bumps stay behind the top-level 14-day gate, which works here because GitHub provides release timestamps.

customManagers.description: Bump the version: field in each umbrel-app.yml in lockstep with its app's Docker image
